ui_input.doc: M2-UI-26 (ADR 0036): input every screen shares, read by the UiInput autoload (game/ui/input/ui_input.gd). cancel_mouse_buttons are Godot MouseButton values that mean Cancel on every screen (2 = right, 8 = the mouse's back button, XBUTTON1); a press becomes a ui_cancel press and release carrying device cancel_device (no real device uses it), so a screen can tell a mouse Cancel apart (the Controls page stops listening on it but swallows a plain ui_cancel). pad_deadzone: stick motion under it does not count as using the pad (for which glyphs show).
